en-US: Build 226 candidate: native iPad IDE workbench with a left activity bar, file/search/Git views, tabs, bottom panel and status bar; multiline chat input with a full prompt editor and conversation drafts; Runtime v2 environment and package-management improvements; native archive operations; and focused local-model, PPT edit-entry, PiP and notification repairs. Please retest local-model load and benchmark, three turns of tool use, opening/editing/saving a PPTX from Workspace, Notes and IDE, existing Linux environment recovery, package persistence, Git source control, and task notifications. Dual-core Linux remains behind its validation gate; an unqualified preinstalled image is not enabled. Report physical-device behavior separately from cloud build results.
zh-Hans: Build 226 候选：iPad 原生 IDE 工作台增加左侧活动栏、文件/搜索/Git 视图、标签页、底部面板和状态栏；聊天输入支持自动换行、完整提示词编辑和按会话保存草稿；改进 Runtime v2 环境及包管理，增加原生归档操作，并专项修复本地模型、PPT 编辑入口、画中画与任务通知。请重点复测本地模型加载与测速、连续三轮工具调用，从工作区/手记/IDE 打开编辑并保存 PPTX、旧 Linux 环境恢复、依赖持久化、Git 源码管理及任务通知。双核 Linux 仍受验证门控制；未经验证的预装镜像不会启用。真机结果请与云端构建结果分别记录。
